الإلهامية التي لا تصل إليها إلا آحاد الموهوبين والله الموفق لفهم الأسرار.
(الفصل التاسع في اسمه تعالى عزيز) هذا الاسم له مربع ٤ × ٤ إلا أنه لا يمكن وضعه إلا بسر
التداخل لتكرر الزاي فيه ومن نقشه في خاتم فضة في شرف المريخ وحمله كانت له عزة على أعدائه
ومن أكثر من ذكره وخاف من الذل لأحد من الأكابر في طلب الحاجات فليكثر ذكره يعطف
الله عليه كل من رآه ويصير عزيزاً عنده وعند غيره ومن كثر من ذكره نال عزة في دينه ودنياه
وأعزه الله بعد ذله وآمنه بعد خوفه ويصلح ذكراً لمن اسمه عبد العزيز ومن فهم سره جعل الله
باطنه بأسرار العزة ألا ترى أنه يشير إلى اسمه تعالى يا جميل بياء النداء وله من العدد ٩٤ وهو زوج فرد
مستطيل، قص أجزاؤه تشير إلى حرف ن الذي هو مدار كل شيء من علم باطن ورزق ظاهر
بحيث يتذلل له كل شيء في طلب ما إليه حاجته ولا سبيل والعزيز بعده الموالي مرتب فالولاية الأولى
الباطن والثانية الظاهر وأما أسماء حروفه ١٧٨ فتشير إلى اسمين جليلين وهما ملك حليم وهذه صورته.
(الفصل العاشر في اسمه تعالى جبار)
من أكثر من ذكره لا ينظر له أحد إلا غشيته منه مهابة ولا يطيق أحد النظر إليه
وله مربع ٤ × ٤ يوضع بسر التداخل في شرف المريخ فحامله يكون مهاباً عند
الناس وكل من رآه وترك مراده، ويصلح ذكراً لمن اسمه عبد
الجبار ولمن كان اسمه موسى وله عدد ٢٨٨ لفظاً و ٢٠٨ وفقاً فالأول هو الزوج والفرد ناقص وهو
من ضرب عدادهم وهو من الأعداد الزائدة أجزاؤه ٢٠٦ تشير إلى اسمه الصادق لما في الخبر
من المصادقة. (نكتة) قال بعض الملوك لوزيره وكان حكيماً لم خلق الله الذباب فقال لإذلال الجبابرة
ينزل على عذرتهم ثم ينزل على لحاهم ولذلك لم يترك الذباب إلا من تمت براءته من هذه الدعوة وهو
نبينا عليه الصلاة والسلام ومن لازم على ذكره ونقشه في صحيفة من نحاس وألقاه في دار ظالم جاز
خربت وهو يصلح للملوك لأنهم إذا داوموا عليه خافهم من سواهم ومن كتب اسمه الجبار واسمه ذو

the number of the wafq of the sevenfold form, and the letter correspondences in it are wondrous secrets for one who has a taste for the divine-inspired wisdom, which is reached only by the singular ones among the gifted, and God is the one who grants success in understanding the secrets.
(Chapter Nine on His, تعالى, Name ʿAzīz) This name has a 4 × 4 square, except that it cannot be placed except by the secret of interpenetration because of the repetition of the zāy in it. And whoever inscribes it in a silver ring in the exaltation of Mars and carries it, there will be for him might over his enemies. And whoever mentions it much and fears humiliation from one of the great ones in seeking needs, let him increase ذكر it; God inclines toward him everyone who sees him, and he becomes mighty with Him and with others. And whoever increases in ذكر it attains might in his religion and his world, and God makes him mighty after his humiliation and secures him after his fear. And it is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz. And whoever understands its secret, God makes his inward with the secrets of might. Do you not see that it indicates His, تعالى, name Yā Jamīl with the yā’ of calling? And it has from the number 94, and it is even-odd, elongated; its cut parts indicate the letter n, which is the axis of everything, from inward knowledge and outward provision, so that everything humbles itself to it in seeking what it needs to it, and there is no way. And al-ʿAzīz after it, the allies are arranged, so the first guardianship is the inward and the second the outward. As for its letters’ names, 178, they indicate two noble names, and they are Malik, Ḥalīm. And this is its image.
(Chapter Ten on His, تعالى, Name Jabbār)
Whoever mentions it much, no one looks at him except awe from it overtakes him, and no one is able to look at him.
And it has a 4 × 4 square placed by the secret of interpenetration in the exaltation of Mars, so its bearer will be awe-inspiring among people, and everyone who sees him and leaves his intention, and it is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is ʿAbd
al-Jabbār and for one whose name is Mūsā. And it has a number of 288 in word-form and 208 in wafq-form; the first is even and the odd deficient, and it is from the multiplication of their counters, and it is from the increased numbers; its parts 206 indicate His, al-Ṣādiq, name because of what is in the report
of agreement. (A subtle point) Some of the kings said to his minister, and he was wise: “Why did God create the fly?” He said: “For the humiliation of the tyrants; it descends upon their dung, then descends upon their beards.” Therefore the fly is not left except by one who has completed his innocence from this claim, and he is our Prophet, upon him الصلاة والسلام. And whoever is constant upon ذكر it and inscribes it on a sheet of brass and throws it in the house of a wrongdoer, it is permissible, ruined. And it is suitable for kings because if they persist in it, others fear them. And whoever writes His name al-Jabbār and His name Dhū al-Jalāl wa-l-Ikrām on a card at any time he wishes while in purity and places it in the front of his head at the time of his sitting among people, God makes him handsome in their eyes and makes them love him. As for its letters’ names, they are 3067, and it is the number of two noble names, outward and inward. And this is the description of its square:
52 58 53 44
52 45 55 52
36 55 56 41
58 48 74 54

48 38 25 52 29
52 32 39 26 41
24 56 52 30 42
22 40 34 24 55
47 39 31 43 35
(Chapter Eleven on His name Mutakabbir) Whoever writes it on the wall of a city or a wall or a house or a garden
or other than that in 94 places in the seventh of Friday
God guards that city or house or other than it from every
evil knocker. And whoever inscribes it in a triangular ring, then interpenetration
by the secret of numbers in the exaltation of Mars, and carries it, every tyrant is humbled to him. And whoever mentions it much likewise, and his ذكر, the tyrants yield to him.

الفاتحة وبعملها ركوع وذكر أيضا واذا فرغ منه كذلك واذا سجد كذلك ويقرأ في الأولى يس والثانية
تبارك ويسأل حاجته تقضى وله من العدد ٨٨٩ وهو فرد مستطيل من الاسماء الوترية لفظا ورقا
لانه من ضرب ٧×١٣٧ وهو عدد ناقص أجزاؤه ١٢٥ تشير إلى اسمه المدني بالمافي الفتح من
الادناء وله من العدد ١٢٧ تشير إلى اسمه المؤمن بال وأما حروفه فهي ٤١٧ تشير إلى اسمين
جليلين وهما متين ماجد وهذا مربعه

(الفصل العشرون في اسمه تعالى عليم) هذا الاسم من أكثر من ذكره
أطلعه الله على دقائق الامور وخفيات العلوم ومن نقشه في صحيفة من زئبق
معقود في شرف عطارد وحملها معه أنطقه الله بالحكمة وعلمه لطائف المعارف
ومن وضعه في صحيفة من فضة في شرف المشتري وحملها رزقه الله الفهم في
العلوم الشرعية ويصلح ذكر لمن كان اسمه عيسى ومن كان اسمه سلطان
وهذه صورته وقد يوضع أيضا مثلثا وهذه صورته

ثم كان مظهر العلم من الارواح القدسية والارواح الخيرية اختص بتعليم الانبياء وكان من أشرفهم نبينا
محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وأوحى اليه بالتواضع قال تعالى علمه شديد القوى ولما كانت الروح القدسية
العيساوية أثر النفخة الخيرية لا آدم عليه السلام وكان عيسى أشرف الانبياء بدقائق العلوم ولطائف

(Chapter Sixteen on His تعالى name Qahhār) Whoever calls by this name upon
an oppressor in seclusion, he is taken at his time. And whoever inscribes it in a square in the exaltation of Mars and carries it, then
he does not contend with anyone except he overcomes him and subdues him by argument. And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever his name is ʿAbd al-Qahhār. And there is
for it the number 311 in words and 356 in numerals. As for the names of its letters, they are 396, indicating
two noble names, and they are Fāṭir Muqsiṭ. And this is the description of its square

(Chapter Seventeen on His تعالى name Wahhāb) Whoever persists in
its dhikr sees the provisions how they are divided. And whoever mentions it كثيرًا, God expands his provision.
And whoever inscribes it on paper in the exaltation of Saturn and carries it subdues his self and prevents it from desires.
And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever his name is ʿAbd al-Wahhāb. And there is for it the number 14 in words and 602 in numerals. As for the names of its letters,
499, they indicate two noble names, and they are Fāṭir Muqsiṭ. And whoever remembers it asks nothing except that He gives it to him. And it is suitable
as a dhikr for whoever his name is Sulaymān, and it is from the odd and even secrets, so its oddness is in the consonant and its evenness in its number.
Therefore, from the aspect of the number 14 and from the aspect of the word 19, the first is an indication of al-Jawwād because of what is in it of secrets
and effusion; therefore it corresponds to the one and the first. The even odd deficient number, its parts 9 indicate a letter for it which the meaning of giving necessitates
for the given one, and its parts 142 indicate His تعالى name Yā Salām by the vocative. As for its square, it is this

(Chapter Eighteen on His تعالى name Razzāq) This name is from the dhikrs of Mīkā’īl
peace be upon him; no one mentions it except that God makes easy for him his food and his drink and the apportioned provision. And whoever
inscribes it on a seal ring and wears it, and mentions it كثيرًا on the night of the middle of the month of Shaʿbān, God provides him with the provision
of his generality. And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever his name is ʿAbd al-Razzāq, and for whoever his name is Yūsuf. And there is for it
the number 31 and 28 in numerals, so it is among the names that gather the secret of oddness and evenness. As for its verbal number, it is
from the multiplication of the first number by the first complete number, then from the multiplication of the sum of one of them in the other; so its dual is from أ ج هـ
and to it ك افيه the standingness of the alif, and the hunger of the jīm, and the insides of the hā’, and its eye, and the eye of the zāy, and the yā’ is left and the kāf becomes
and the repetition of the zāy. In it is every word and number, as though the seeker of provision must inevitably be afflicted by hardship in obtaining it.
And it is a number whose utmost parts are 311, indicating his name Qahhār. So everyone who seeks provision from someone is humbled to him and enters
under his subjugation. (Wisdom) Adhere, O father, to one, the doors will open for you, and submit to one master, the necks will submit to you.

## Page 174

**Arabic (original):**

الحكم، وكان من علومه علم الحرف، ومن ثم كان اسمه عنده، وهذه أمة عيسى لما يدل عليه من العلم،
والعين والياء من لطف التنزيل، والسين من جوامع التفضيل، والألف من الإحاطة، وكافُه من العدد
١٥٠ وذلك أعم علم، ولما كان من علم خفيات الأمر وقيل فيه عليم يشير إلى ذلك يكتب باسمه عليم فصار
عدده ١٤١، وأما أسماء حروفه ٢٩٢ فتشير إلى بصير، ولما كان العالم آية مظهرة للمطلوب متصلة به اتصالاً
تاماً، وقد يقال حصول عين متصلة بتمام المعنى، ولهذا لاحظ من قال: هو حصول صورة الشيء في الذهن،
فمعنى العلي على كل حال من ظهر له عين شيء ظهوراً متصلاً بظاهر كل شيء وباطنه، وهو من الأسرار
التي لا تصلح فيه المبالغة بالولما فيها من العلوم إلا بعد غايات جميع الموجودات، وإنما يبالغ فيه بأحد
أمرين: إما بالتكثير فيقال علّام فيكون للدلالة على التنزيل للدقائق وإدراك الحقائق، ولا يقال
عليم إلا لمن يعلم الدقائق كإيعلم الجلائل ويعلم الخفيات كإيعلم الجليات، قال تعالى: {وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ}
فذو العلم من يعلم كليات الأمور، والعالم من يعلم ظواهر الأمور، والعليم من يعلم جليات الأمور وخفياتها،
وتذكر أن يجمع على كثير من العلماء فقال بالجزئيات، قال تعالى: {وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ} فإنه إن فوقية العلماء
على بعض لا تكون بكثرة المعلومات، إذ لو كانت كذلك لما قال لنبيه موسى عليه السلام لنعبد
عند مجمع البحرين يقال له الخضر وهو أعلم منك، ولم يكن الخضر عليه السلام أعلم من موسى بمعنى أنه
أكثر معلومات، كيف لا وقد قال الله تعالى في حق موسى: {وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً
وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ} وإنما المراد أنه يعلم بواطن معلوماته كإيعلم ظواهرها، ولذلك كان مكانه مجمع
البحرين اللذين هما بحر الظاهر والباطن، وقد اعترف لموسى بأنه على علم من علم الله لا يعلمه هو،
فاجتهد أيها الواقف على هذه الكلمات أن تكون عالماً علامة، وهذا هو المعنى الذي أمر الله نبيه
بطلبه في قوله: {وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا} وفضل العلم مشهور فتدبر المعنى والله الموفق.

(الفصل الحادي والعشرون في اسمه تعالى قابض) من ذكر هذا الاسم غلب عليه الجلال والهيبة
ولا يطيق أحد مجالسته، ومن رسمه في صحيفة من رصاص في شرف زحل وذكر الاسم عدده وقال:
اللهم اقبض على فلان قلبه وسره استجيب له، وهو من أذكار عزرائيل عليه السلام وفيه سر قبض
الأرواح، وله مربع جليل القدر وقد جمع بين مربعه الحرفي ومثله العددي، ومن أراد قبض روح
أحد فليتخذه ذكراً دائماً ويذكر اسم من أراد هلاكه فإنه يهلك فاتق الله، ومن أكثر من ذكره
أقبلت عليه عوالمه ويرى آثار انفعالات في نفسه وفي غيره بقدر اجتهاده وصفاء باطنه، وهذه صورته:

**English:**
— 168 —

the حكم, and among his sciences was the science of letters, and from this his name was with him, and this is the community of Jesus because of what knowledge it indicates, and the ʿayn and the yāʾ are from the gentleness of the revelation, and the sīn from the comprehensive excellences of preference, and the alif from encompassing, and its kāf is from the number 150, and that is the most general knowledge; and since it was from the knowledge of the hidden matters of the affair, and it was said concerning it “ʿAlīm,” indicating that, it is written with his name “ʿAlīm,” so its number became 141, and as for the names of its letters, 292, they indicate “Baṣīr”; and since the world is a manifest sign for the sought one, connected to him with a complete connection, and it may be said [to be] the obtaining of an ʿayn connected with the completion of the meaning, and for this reason he observed the one who said: it is the obtaining of the form of the thing in the mind, so the meaning of al-ʿAliyy, in any case, is that for whom the ʿayn of a thing has become manifest, a manifestation connected to the outward of every thing and its inward, and it is from the secrets in which exaggeration with al-walmā is not suitable because of the sciences in it except after the utmost of all existents; and one only exaggerates in it by one of two matters: either by intensification, so it is said ʿAllām, and it is for indicating the revelation of subtleties and the apprehension of realities, and “ʿAlīm” is not said except of one who knows subtleties, as he knows the great matters, and knows the hidden matters as he knows the manifest matters. He تعالى said: {AND ABOVE EVERY ONE POSSESSING KNOWLEDGE IS ONE MORE KNOWING} so the possessor of knowledge is one who knows the universals of affairs, and the world is one who knows the outward aspects of affairs, and the knowing one is one who knows the manifest matters of affairs and their hidden matters, and remember that it is pluralized over many of the scholars, so he said concerning particulars. He تعالى said: {AND ABOVE EVERY ONE POSSESSING KNOWLEDGE} for the superiority of scholars over one another is not by the abundance of information, since if it were so, he would not have said to his prophet Moses عليه السلام to worship at the meeting-place of the two seas, one called al-Khiḍr, and he is more knowing than you; and al-Khiḍr عليه السلام was not more knowing than Moses in the sense that he had more information—how could he not, when Allah تعالى said concerning Moses: {AND WE WROTE FOR HIM IN THE TABLETS OF EVERYTHING AN ADMONITION AND A DETAILED EXPLANATION OF EVERYTHING}? Rather, what is meant is that he knows the inward aspects of his known things as he knows their outward aspects; and therefore his place was the meeting-place of the two seas, which are the sea of the outward and the inward, and he acknowledged to Moses that he was upon knowledge from the knowledge of Allah that he did not know. So strive, O you who stand upon these words, to be a scholar, a great scholar, and this is the meaning that Allah commanded His prophet to seek in His saying: {AND SAY: MY LORD, INCREASE ME IN KNOWLEDGE}; and the فضل of knowledge is famous, so reflect upon the meaning, and Allah is the One who grants success.

(Chapter twenty-one on His تعالى name Qābiḍ) Whoever ذكر this name, majesty and awe prevail over him, and no one is able to keep his company; and whoever draws it on a sheet of lead in the exaltation of Saturn and mentions the number of the name and says: “O Allah, seize the heart and secret of so-and-so,” it is answered for him. It is among the remembrances of ʿAzrāʾīl عليه السلام, and in it is the secret of seizing souls. It has a square of great value, and its letter-square has been joined with its numerical equivalent. (Chapter twenty-two on His تعالى name Bāsiṭ) No fearful one mentions it except that he becomes secure, and no sorrowful one except that he rejoices. Whoever engraves it on a ring in the first hour of Friday and carries it, his joy and gladness increase, and everyone who sees him loves him. And if the one of a state recites it, Allah expands his provision and revives his heart with knowledges. It is among the remembrances of Isrāfīl, and by it the secret of giving life appeared, just as by al-Qābiḍ the secret of causing death appeared. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Maḥmūd. Whoever persists in mentioning it, his soul becomes easy, and provision is expanded for him. Whoever persists upon it until the state of his other worlds overcomes the state of his response, it indicates His تعالى name Qarīb. It has from the number 72; the two indicates the seven, and the seventy-two indicates the very essence of the thing and its power from the meaning of preference which the sīn necessitates; therefore the alif is from it, and whoever seizes it frightens him. And as for the names of its letters, 249, they indicate His name al-Ẓāhir. It is placed in a numerical triangle surrounded by a letter-square, and this is its form as you see.

(Chapter twenty-three on His تعالى name Khāfiḍ) It is suitable for supplication against the wicked and for cutting off the tail of the الظالم. Its number is read as Muḍar, and the remainder of the name of the الظالم in the depth of the night, his destruction is obtained. It has from the number 1481, and it is a prime number. And as for the names of its letters, 1599, they indicate two names, and they are Mughīth, Mājid. And this is its form.

(Chapter twenty-four on His تعالى name Rāfiʿ) Whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah opens for him the raising of his rank and his remembrance, and if he is a man of conduct and characterizes himself by it, justice is inspired to him in his movements and his stillnesses. It has from the number 1251, and it is a stretched composite, deficient; its parts indicate Muqsiṭ. And as for the names of its letters, they are 45, indicating two gentle remembrances, and they are Mālik al-Mulk, Qarīb. And this is the form of its square.

(Chapter twenty-five on His تعالى name Muʿizz) This name—no one who persists in mentioning it while abased except that he becomes mighty, and no hidden one except that he becomes manifest. It is for strength and assistance in getting rid of the coverings of nature. Whoever engraves it in a square and carries it is awe-inspiring among people, and every tyrannical, obstinate one is terrified by it. It is among the greatest remembrances of the believers. It has from the number 124, and it is the even of the even and the odd; its deficient parts indicate a letter from the letters of encompassing, and it is 10, and it يدل upon length and strength and encompassing, and it is the qāf. (Chapter twenty-six on His تعالى name Mudhill) This name, of exalted شأن—whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah abases for him whatever He wills of his enemies. Whoever takes it as a remembrance after fasting three days, the last of them Friday, and refrains on Friday from breaking the fast, and prays two rakʿahs, and mentions the name one hundred times after al-Fātiḥah, and when he prostrates does likewise, and in the second rakʿah likewise, and he gives salām and mentions the name after the salām one thousand times and says: “O Mudhill, abase so-and-so for me,” then he will be abased for him and will not مخالفة him in any matter of the matters. (A subtle point) When the people of inner sight witnessed with the fingers of their hearts the dāl of abasement, its place being the lām of gentleness and connection, they knew that there is no connection to Him except by abasement, so they equaled the dogs in eating from the refuse heaps, and the might that has no interruption was completed for them, and they were delivered from the predicament of abasement to other than Him until they knew by faith and witnessed beneficence and knew that there is no abaser except Allah. And it has from the number 707, and it is the even of the even from it to the odd in b, حاصل from the multiplication of a stretched [figure] in a place, and its parts 1096 indicate the exaltation of the wāw, and by the ninety the ṣamadāniyyah of the ṣād, and by the alif to the utmost of the ghayn. (Chapter thirty on His, تعالى, name Adl) This splendid name and the manifest secret: whoever calls upon it against an oppressor, his strength is taken. As for the four, it is for indicating permanence and the expansion of kingship, and the kingdoms have narrowed and the states have shortened because of the abundance of injustice. And this number is from the numbers of even-even and odd, the زائد; its parts, 106, indicate His name Munji and to His name وفي فمن وفي فقد عدل in his subjects, and saved himself from blame and his subjects from injustice. He, تعالى, said: “O David, We have made you a vicegerent in the earth, so judge between the people with truth and do not follow desire, lest it lead you astray from the path of Allah.” (Note) When a cushion was thrown to ʿUmar, رضي الله عنه, ʿUmar said: “This is the first injustice.” ʿUmar intended that whoever is a judge should not prefer one over another by what suits his desire and purpose. And he said that if people are not equal, it is injustice. And this is the seal.
(Chapter thirty-one on His, تعالى, name Latif) This name is quick in response for relieving distress at times of hardships, and it is suitable as a ذكر for prisoners and captives and whoever is afflicted by severe illness and whoever is subjugated under an unjust سلطان or the سلطان of his nature. Whoever increases in mentioning it is delivered from that. And it is mentioned by it for whoever’s name is Salih. And it has from the number 129, and it is an odd elongated number after it the three and forty-three, and it is deficient. Its parts, 47, indicate the governor, because in لطف there is ولاية, to the name Mubdi' because in it there is return to the حكم of the fitrah; and from this its first number is by three. * As for the names of its letters, they indicate His name Muqbil.

۞ And know that this name has noble properties in relieving distress at times of hardships, and nothing else is added to it; wonder appears from its effects. And whoever takes charge of it does not mention it with anything in himself or his body, there remains not in its midst Allah repeated. And in that are wondrous secrets, and Allah is the One who grants success.
(Chapter thirty-two on His, تعالى, name Khabir)
This name is suitable as a ذكر for whoever desires اطلاع upon a hidden matter in his sleep or his waking, and whoever places it in a square in the exaltation of Mercury and places it under his head will become aware of hidden matters. And whoever mentions it for 7 days in seclusion and spiritual exercise, the Ruhaniyyah comes to him with every خبر he desires, from the أخبار of the year or from the أخبار of kings. And its number is 838, and it is even odd زائد. Its parts, 268, indicate two noble names, and they are Khaliq and Wasiʿ, for none informs of things upon their reality except one who has expanded them in knowledge and originated them in creation. And this is the description of its square.

And it is from the noble names; none knows its value except the knowers. And it has from the number 88, and it is even-even and odd زائد. Its parts, 93, indicate His, تعالى, name Aman. And this name is from the most special names of our master Muhammad, عليه السلام; therefore his supplication was: “O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.” And therefore his name, its number, is a talisman indicating this name. As for the names of its letters, 183, they indicate his name Majid by one consideration and to his name Mata by one consideration. And this is its square.

**English:**
(Chapter thirty-four on His, تعالى, name ʿAzim) This red sulfur and the greatest magnet: whoever persists in mentioning it, Allah gives him enduring might, and he becomes great in the eyes of people and his faults are concealed from them. If its possessor is in a true state and complete turning, he witnesses the command of Allah, تعالى, for the universes, and witnesses the secrets in every seclusion. And whoever persists in mentioning it, Allah gives him enduring might, and everyone who sees him loves him and he becomes great in the eyes of people. And it has from the number 1020, and it is even-even, increased according to what greatness requires from the nine. Its parts, 191, increase over the الأصل and ع غ. So the waw is for loftiness, that is, the collectives of the preference of existence, and the ʿayn is an indication of concealment; so glory be to the One who is hidden by the intensity of His manifestation. And the ghayn is the name Ghani and the light of light, and for the ya' to descend upon the manifestation of the ghayn and the consideration of the numbers of the rest of this name and the exits of its parts, as comes out from the limit of abbreviation, but there has been obtained from the similitude that in it is sufficiency for whoever casts the hearing while he is a witness. As for the names of its letters, they are 331, indicating two noble names, and they are Ghalib, Maniḥ. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter thirty-five on His, تعالى, name Ghafur)
Whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah saves him from what he fears and warns against. And it is a secret in calming the anger of kings, and it is suitable for whoever is in the service of the sultans, and it is suitable as a ذكر for whoever is overcome by sorrow or was among the wayfarers. And it has from the number 1286, and it is even odd deficient. Its parts, 339, indicate His name 536, for He, تعالى, is odd and His oddities are even. And it is from the names whose numbers are deficient by their letters. As for the names of its letters, they are 132, indicating two noble names, and they are Dhu al-ʿArsh, Majid. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter thirty-six on His, تعالى, name Shakur)
Whoever increases in mentioning it, the truth thanks His, تعالى, acts, and it is a help for him toward what he wants of acts of الخير, and by it the blessings are established and its stray ones are returned. And in it are secrets for the people of unveilings, which they witness when they تحقق by it. And it has from the number 526; so the six indicates loftiness, and the twenty to what has appeared from the high place, and the five hundred indicates مرة 500, so it is the utmost of the ranks of manifestation. And it is even odd elongated; its parts, 666, indicate His, تعالى, name Niʿm al-Dayyan. And in it is an indication of the nurturing of the breast, just as one of us nurtures his colt and his foal. As for the names of its letters, they are 65, indicating two noble names, and they are Sattar, Jawad. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter thirty-seven on His, تعالى, name ʿAli)
Whoever increases in mentioning this name, Allah ennobles his face from humbling himself to others, and everyone who sees him loves him, and Allah supports him with His victory, and releases him with wisdom, and [teaches] the subtleties of the sciences. And whoever increases in mentioning it, Allah raises his rank and elevates him, and everyone who sees him loves him.

And every one who called him was led to him, and he saw in his age the shining exaltation, and in himself the dazzling loftiness, and in him a wondrous secret for the shaykhs and the great ones and the seekers of the sciences and the lights. Whoever is successful in it, in a ring of gold, and perfumes it with oud, and carries it with him, then everyone who sees him submits to him. And the kings used to take it, from al-Saffah until our time, may God establish their kingship. And al-Ma’mun was asked: how are you, when the kings of Persia have come to you? So he brought out his hand with a ring in which the two names were set upright and said: no one is able against us so long as this is with us. And the fitting time for it is the honor of the moon, and this is its form.

And this name has, from the number, 125. He تعالى said: “And God is encompassing over them” etc. And since its manifestation in everything is existence, and its veiling when it is raised is by the requirement of His wisdom, necessarily the number indicates its exclusiveness. And God has described with wisdom what He described with loftiness. He تعالى said: “And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, surely exalted, wise.” And it is among the numbers of the even and the odd, and the sum of its parts is 42, increasing upon it by its like, and it is as though it says: ‘Ali or higher, He is the Wise. As for the names of its letters, they are 200, indicating His name Malik al-Mulk. And this is its form.

Whoever increases in mentioning it, every thing becomes small in his sight, and no one sees him except that he fears him. And it is among the majestic remembrances that are mentioned with kings and tyrants, so their souls become small before him in certainty. As for its square, it is upon this form.

(Chapter Thirty-Nine on His تعالى name, Hafiz)

Whoever increases in mentioning it in his travel, God preserves him until his return from it. And whoever draws it in a page in the honor of Jupiter, it is not placed in anything except that God preserves it. And whoever increases in mentioning it is محفوظ from every disliked thing. And it is the square of response for the fearful in travels, for whoever remembers it is secure in his homeland from fear and sees no disliked thing. And it has been timed in the places of dread and seizure, so I turned to its ذكر and saw from the wonders of God’s making what no one reaches. And whoever engraves it on the bezel of a silver ring and makes its number according to the breaking of letters in the interior of the ring and carries it, then he is in the midst of beasts and no harm reaches him. And he says after it: “O Hafiz, preserve me” 3 times; the sought thing is obtained. And this is its form, literally and numerically.

and his creation and his knowledge, and makes ample for him his term. And it is among the noble names, and its bearer does not obtain constriction; rather he finds expansiveness, and Allah makes
for him in his affair relief and an outlet. Whoever persists upon this جامع, radiant name and the lofty, dazzling secret, Allah تعالى expands
for him his provision and expands his breast. Whoever breaks it in a 4×4 square in the increase of the moon and remembers its number after reciting
al-Fātiḥa and carries it with him, Allah makes the difficult matters easy and makes provision easy for him. In it is a wondrous secret for kings, princes, and notables.
And every king who increases in its ذكر, his kingdom expands and his word spreads. And it has the number 137: the seven for getting out of constriction,
and the thirty for the arrangement of all the names in Wāsi‘ and its connection, and the hundred for its encompassing and its manifestation. Therefore the number was جامعًا
for the first of the names in manifestation and the one descending in appearance, which in truth is the last of them in manifestation, and that is because it is Malik. And this number, if
its like is carried upon it, that is more expansive, and ذات is an indication of Muḥammad, صلى الله عليه وسلم, and he is the one indicated by His saying, “My believing servant’s heart has expanded me.”
And this is from the prime numbers. It was only so because the outward wording, when it necessitated
the ظرفية for every thing such that its manifestation would be an obstacle between the manifestation of every thing, then the joining was more deserving of this meaning than
the splitting, and He تعالى is sanctified from that a thing should dwell in Him or that a thing should dwell in it. Rather, it is a noble indication understood by subtle
tastes. (Nukta) Whoever witnesses the عظَمة said: I saw nothing except that I saw Allah before it. And the eye is the inward of the عظَمة, and it is
the outward of expansiveness; therefore the عظَمة was an izār, so understand that, for it is among the subtleties of tawḥīd. As for the names | ع | س |
of its letters, 137, they indicate His name, that spirit, because of the vastness of its encompassing. And this is the form of its square as you see | 66 | 52 | 5
| 3 | 8 | 66 | 58 | 7 | 4

( Chapter forty-seven in His تعالى name Ḥakīm )
Whoever increases in its ذكر, Allah inspires him with wisdom and teaches him the subtleties of the sciences, the wonders of meanings, and the subtleties
of indications. And it is among the noble names. Whoever places it in the first hour of Wednesday in the exaltation of Mercury in
a body suitable to it, carrying it with him, remembering the name, characterizing himself with the character of the wise, and comporting himself with their manners, the divine effusion is doubled upon him,
and the springs of wisdom burst forth from his heart upon his tongue. And action is conditioned upon purifying the النفس. Whoever increases in its ذكر understands
the realities of the secrets of meanings, and it is among the stored secrets and the hidden lights. Whoever places it in a sheet of bound mercury
in the exaltation of Mercury and carries it, is provided with understanding in the sciences of wisdom, and the wise have made its ذكر suitable. And it has the number 87, and it is even-
odd, its parts exceeding 9, indicating His تعالى name Mālik, and it is the lowest of the descents of wisdom. As for the names of its letters, they are 217, considering
211. The first consideration indicates His تعالى name ‘Ālim, and from it is a manifest prophet, and the second consideration indicates His تعالى name Bāri‘ because of what is in
the burh

**English:**
It is the singling out of love and the affection of compassion, and it is the emptying of the will in the beloved and attachment to him; and Allah is the One who grants success.

(Chapter Forty-Nine on His, تعالى, Name Majid)
This name, of great شأن and sublime proof, is suitable as a remembrance for kings, because if they persist upon it their kingdom expands. It is also suitable for the poles and the successors, and for whoever remembers it such that a state from it prevails over him, his word is not repelled. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Abd al-Majid. Whoever persists in its remembrance and is a possessor of a true state, Allah makes the affairs easy for him, revives his spirit with knowledges, and strengthens his inward with the subtleties of secrets. In it is a great secret for the manifestation of hidden things and treasures and for finding the hidden things of symbols. Its number is 57. The seven is an indication that it is of one who is freed from the consequences of kingship, and none is freed from that except one who is active in what he wills, and that is none but Allah تعالى. And the fifty is an indication that it is of one in whose hand is the course of every thing, and that also is among what He, سبحانه وتعالى, conceals. And it is a single deficient elongated one; its parts, 31, indicate the first alif and the iqāmah, the kaf of the word. As for the names of its letters, they are by consideration 190 and by consideration 188. The first consideration indicates His, تعالى, name: He is Allah, the One, the Necessary Existent. And by the second consideration it indicates His name, Master of all. And this is its form as you see.

(Chapter Fifty on His, تعالى, Name Ba'ith)
This greatest name and the brightest secret is suitable for one whose resolve concerning a matter has weakened; whoever increases in its remembrance is impelled toward every good. Some of them said: it is the domination of life and health over bodies and the preservation of powers. If you desire that, enter seclusion and recite the name in an prepared seclusion and an emptied heart until a state from it occurs for you, for Allah extends to you powers and your aspiration is strengthened for the doing of obedience. Whoever inscribes this name in a tablet of lead in the first [hour/day] of Saturday, then remembers it 4011 times while looking at its shaklah, then says: O Ba'ith, I have empowered you over such-and-such, then that will be so. Its number is 572. The ayn and the fa in it remain upon their state. And take the means by the upright alif, which is the Causer of causes. And this number is a single deficient one; its parts indicate His name Sadiq and Master of masters. And this is its form.

(Chapter Fifty-One on His, تعالى, Name Shahid)
Whoever persists in its remembrance, watchfulness is commanded for him in his seclusions and his public states. And if he is a possessor of a true state, that is formed for him, and his soul is molded by the attribute of unity and isolation, so he is safe from excess and deficiency in all the qualities of his soul. It is among the noblest remembrances and is suitable for one who seeks the rank of martyrdom. I have commanded some people to remember it, and martyrdom occurred for them. Whoever draws it in the first [hour/day] of Friday on paper, the number of its outward powers, and places it upon his heart without any barrier, the forms testify to his generosity and فضل, and the mouths speak of his right guidance, and Allah grants him awe, joy, and dignity. Its number is 312, and it is a prime number because its meaning, what it contains of threat, is a sealing in which there is no opening. And sufficient is Allah as Witness. And the names of its letters are 319

indicate

Whoever increases in its remembrance, Allah تعالى establishes him upon acts of obedience and shows him the realities of affairs and informs him of the hidden things of secrets and makes falsehood hateful to him and makes his word high, overpowering. And by it Allah establishes those who believe. Whoever inscribes its square, and the ascendant is one of the fixed signs, on an instrument, intending the stability of a thing therein, Allah establishes that thing. And it is after the remembrance of the name until a state from it prevails over him, and he writes around the square. As for what benefits people, it remains in the earth. Its number is 1008 in form. As for the first, it is the pair of the pair and the single, plus its parts 432, indicating the name Sabur Sadiq because of what is in the sad of the secret of correspondence in the body. As for the second, it is the pair of the pair; its parts 172 indicate His name Muqbil. As for its square, it is upon this description.

(Chapter Fifty-Three on His, تعالى, Name Wakil)
Whoever increases in its remembrance, Allah suffices him and enriches him from the means, and provides him from where he does not reckon. And if he is a possessor of a true state, the stillness is perfected and he begins to act within it. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Muhammad. Its number is 66, and it is a stretched even-single. It is among the names specific to Muhammad, عليه السلام; for that reason Allah named him in the books al-Mutawakkil. And because of the collectivity of this name, its specificity to the Prophet, عليه السلام, is established; for that reason the جامع name matched a number, so Allah was 66 and Wakil likewise, and the sum of that is 132. His name, عليه السلام, Muhammad—this number is in addition to what has been established. Its parts, 78, indicate His, تعالى, name Hakim, for the wakil, if he is not wise, does not place things in their place. And poetry was said regarding that:
If you are sent in need, then send a wise one and do not instruct him.
It has a triangle of noble value, and this is its form as you see.
And the parts of each of the two names indicate its origin, and that is his name Ahabb, and it is among the most specific of his names, عليه السلام. (Note) If the increase of one of them to the other is joined, that is 94, and it is his name, عليه السلام, and his beloved, just as the sum of each of them was the name Ahabb or Wakil, حب. As for the names of its letters, they are 198, indicating His, تعالى, name al-Qayyum, because in agency is the standing with the thing.

(Chapter Fifty-Four on His, تعالى, Name Qawi)
Whoever increases in its remembrance becomes strong in bearing the outward and inward burdens, and his spirit becomes strong. It is among the remembrances of Azra'il, عليه السلام, and is suitable as a remembrance for one who suffers bearing burdens, and is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Musa. And it should be added to it al-Mubdi'. Whoever persists in its remembrance will never tire in his journey. Its number is 126, and it is a stretched even-single plus its parts 920, indicating a noble remembrance: whoever attaches himself to it, nothing will disgrace him, and it is Allah 94. This is what its numbers make you understand in word. And if it is considered as a number, it is 116, and it is a stretched even-single deficient; its parts 29 indicate His, تعالى, name Aziz.

فإنه أمر ذو بال، فلو لم يبدأ في محمد الله الذي هو محمد خلقه وأحمد هم لكان أجذم، ولذلك كانت دعوى
النبيين دعوته بنص، وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد لله رب العالمين، فهو صلى الله عليه وسلم الفاتح الخاتم، كما افتتح
به الحق تعالى كتاب الابداء، فكذلك يفتتح به كتاب الاعادة، كما قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: أنا أول من

حروفه ١٣٠ فتشير إلى اسمه آخر مهيمن والجامع، وأما مربعه فعلى هذه الصفة:

هذا الاسم الفخيم الجليل البرهان، من أكثر من ذكره أورثه الله تعالى المراقبة،
ويصلح ذكراً لمن يصلح له الحصيب، وله من العدد ١٤٨، فالثمانية للكمال،
والأربعون للمائة للإحاطة، والمحصى من له كمال تام محيط، وهذا العدد زوج الزوج والفرد
ناقص أجزاؤه ١١٨ تشير إلى اسمه تعالى حي عند أهل الأسرار، وملك عند أهل الأنوار، وذلك لما
تقضى الحياة من الملك، والكمال من الإحاطة به. تنبيه: اعلم أن جميع ما تقدم من الأسماء من اسمه الرحيم
إلى اسمه الحمد أعلامها إنما يتعلق بمعنى الأسباب كالوهاب والكريم والرزاق وأمثالها كالعليم
والحكيم والسميع والبصير وشبهها، وقد حصل خاتمتها الحمد، وما انتظم لها من اسمه المحصى إلى اسمه
الصبور فعامتها موجودة للعبد، فما يأتي ذلك في المحصى والمبدئ وغيره إن شاء الله
تعالى إلى الصبور، وفي وحدة المعرفة ظهرت في اسمه الهادي، وأما أسماء حروفه ٥٠ فتشير إلى اسمين
جليلين وهما عزيز كافي، وأما مربعه فهو هذا:

هذا الاسم النوراني والسر الرباني، من أكثر من ذكره بدت له خفيات الأمور،

لمن أراد إنجاز أمره في علم الكون، ولمن ابتدأ في أمر وذكره كان تاماً مباركاً لكل ما ابتدأ فيه،
ويصلح ذكراً لمن يريد الابتداء في تأليف العلوم السنية والأشعار النحوية، وله من العدد ٥٦، وهو

(Chapter Sixty-Four on His تعالى name Qayyūm)
This radiant name and noble, dazzling secret: whoever mentions it much, God تعالى establishes his affair outwardly and inwardly. If he is a possessor of a true state, God establishes by him everything. It is suitable as a remembrance for one whose name is Yūsuf, and in that is a verification that is not hidden. * And know that qayyūmiyyah is خاص to Him تعالى, for He تعالى is قائم over every soul for what it has earned, and God is encompassing behind them, the verse, and He is with you wherever you are, and God is Seeing of what you do, Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests; so wherever you turn, there is the Face of God. Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you are only pledging allegiance to God; the hand of God is فوق their hands. Did they not know that God is He who accepts repentance from His servants? And you did not throw when you threw, but God threw. Charity falls into the palm of the Merciful. “He was ill and did not visit me,” and the ḥadīth: “I was his hearing and his sight.” And His تعالى name al-Qayyūm is a plain encompassing of His monotheism by every name of His names, outward from creation and inward from command, and a barzakh between them: “God, there is no god but He, the Living, the Qayyūm.” And We created not the heavens and the earth and what is between them. So the name of God تعالى was not exceeded by other than Him, because of what the Creator sees of His monotheism; likewise the name al-Qayyūm, and it is among what God has restricted tongues from, so none other than Him is named by it. * And know that the greatest name of God تعالى is in these two verses: “And your God is one God; there is no god but He, the Merciful, the Compassionate,” “God, there is no god but He, the Living, the Qayyūm,” as has come in the report. And the greatest name of God is that which, if it is invoked, its names vanish by its qayyūmiyyah. * “Lo, everything except God is false.” * And the living die in every state. “Everyone upon it is perishing, and there remains the Face of your Lord, Possessor of Majesty and Honor. You are dying, and they are dying.” And everything perishes: “There is no god but God” in His majesty. And there is none of the god except those whom you call upon besides God; they will not create a fly, even if they gathered for it. And it has from the number 667, and it is even-odd deficient whose parts are 176, indicating His name Muʾammal and His name Badīʿ, for the value of every thing in truth is only wondrous, as He تعالى said: “Originator of the heavens and the earth.” And this number indicates the highest of the names in establishment and the lowest of them in descent, and that is His تعالى name Malik, if you consider its letters as utterance. But if you consider it numerically, then it is from the number 102, and it is even-odd plus whose parts are 136. (Chapter Sixty-Seven on His Exalted Name, Wahid)
This self-sufficient name and spiritual secret: whoever increases in its remembrance
becomes estranged from multitude. And in it is a subtle secret for one who desires the barrenness of a man
or a woman from children; let him increase in its remembrance with that intention, and that will be obtained for him. So let him fear Allah تعالى. And it is among the adhkar
of the great ones. And the author of Taysir al-Matalib, قدس الله روحه, said: this name is among the nearest of names to the Essence,
and if it is added to the جامع name, it is among the greatest of remembrances and its most sublime. And it is a hint for one whose name is Ahmad.
And know that His name al-Wahid and al-Ahad is a noble remembrance, عظیم in شأن, for the wayfarers attached to the secrets of tawhid.
And Abu عبد الله al-Kufi said that His name al-Ahad is suitable for the people of annihilation in the حضرة of gathering, for they behold nothing except One.
And whoever increases in its remembrance, Allah تعالى opens tawhid for him. And this is its form as you see:

And whoever inscribes these two noble names on paper in the first of Sunday while facing the qiblah, in purity and remembrance, and places it in his head,
Allah تعالى will provide him with might, awe, dignity, and greatness. And this name has the number
13, and it is an odd number, because the meaning of al-Ahad is a joining with no opening in it. As for the names
of its letters, they are 65. The first number indicates His Exalted Name, Matin,
because of what is in ahadiyyah of the meaning of the Name of Allah تعالى, and therefore it came after it in Surat
al-Ikhlas. And it also indicates His Exalted Name, Ali, because of what is in loftiness of the perceptions of creation, since it is an explication of the جامع name.
And the second number indicates His name Mu’nis, for by the oneness of the Truth every estranged one finds intimacy with other than Him. And
whoever increases in its remembrance becomes estranged from multitude. And this is the form of its square as you see:

Abu عبد الله al-Kufi, قدس سره, said in his book Kanz al-Asrar:
Whoever places these names of great value, namely Allah, Ahad, Wahid,
Jawad, Wahhab, Hayy, Mوجد, Dā’im, Wali, Mujib, Wadud, Awwal, Hadi, in a square
and deposits it in the interior of the square of Surat al-Ikhlas and carries it with him, he will witness from the wonders of the صنع of Allah تعالى what does not enter
under count, for every name of these names gives its bearer what is in its power of life of the heart, the spirit of knowledges,
and the subtleties of tawhid. And if the possessor of a truthful state persists in its remembrance, Allah will expand for him his inward and outward provision,
and he does not ask Allah تعالى for anything except that He gives it to him. And they are among the greatest of remembrances, and their end is the utmost, and they are placed for kings

(Chapter Sixty-Eight on His Exalted Name, al-Samad)
This عظیم name and noble secret: whoever increases in its remembrance, his neediness to the end will diminish. And it should be taken
as a remembrance by the blessed masters of spiritual exercises, because of what creation is in need of from eating, drinking, sleeping, and other than that. And if the possessor of a truthful state persists in
its remembrance, needs return to him. And al-Samad is suitable for those afflicted by hunger; so if he remembers it, he does not feel pain

(Chapter Seventy on His تعالى name Muqtadir)
This noble, lofty name and the manifest secret: whoever mentions it كثيراً, Allah تعالى makes easy
for him all الأعمال and crafts and the employed ones from artisans and others, and whoever
wishes to manifest works over one beneath him. And it has a great-value wafq, placed by the secret of interpenetration. And as for His severe
and powerful and subduing and omnipotent name, these are names for subjugation, domination, and mastery; no one invokes them against an oppressor in the burning of the month
at the seventh hour of the night in a dark house, bareheaded, sitting on the ground, with no barrier between him and it,
and it is after the prayer of two rak‘ahs, and he says at the end of every prostration one hundred times: O Severe, take my right from so-and-so, for
that will be so. And among the conditions of supplication against the oppressor is that he not supplicate against him with more than his wrong, and that he supplicate for the oppressed
by himself; and if one other than the oppressed supplicates against him for the sake of the oppressed, it is permitted. * And whoever engraves it on a ring and seals with it, he wears awe
that he perceives from himself, and every stubborn tyrant is comforted by it upon seeing it, for the lawful is upon his shoulder. And this name has from the number

(Chapter Seventy-Two on His تعالى name Mu'akhkhar)
This luminous name and the merciful secret: whoever mentions it often was صاحب
a state in advancing whom he wills and delaying whom he wills, as though advancing in the advanced, and it should not
be mentioned, the advanced name. And know that whoever wishes to advance someone to his rank, let him depict his form in a tablet in the noblest
of forms and place it before him and look at it with gathered resolve, purity of inwardness, and presence of heart while he mentions his advanced name until
a state from it overcomes him, for he will witness the image mentioning with him and he will persist upon that state, then his need will be fulfilled,
especially if he is among the people of states, and more than this cannot be explicitly stated, its following. And it is of its right to be preceding by its joined sirās, every matter is understood, and compare what is absent to what is present; the circle of understanding will expand for you, so be
a believer in it; the gates of the kingdom will be opened for you, the secrets will be bound by it. So glory be to Him who granted the knowers the unveiling of the secrets of guidance
and the erasure of the contented ones from the source of the lights of lordlyness. And this name has from the number 1446 in words and 845 in digits.
As for its number in words, it is an even-odd زائد; its parts, 1408, indicate two noble names, and they are Mulaqq li-Ruh Ghalib
and it increases over its أصل by its name Wajib, and its parts increase over its أصل by what its cast name indicates, and it is جد ل قدر
known to the people of insight, and it is from the stored secrets. And this is its description.

(Chapter Seventy-Five on His تعالى name al-Zahir)
This name of lofty rank and manifest secret: whoever mentions it often, Allah manifests to him
the hidden things of affairs, and by it the hidden treasures are extracted. And whoever engraves it on a sword and fights with it
will be the victor over his enemies, especially one of true state. And it has from the number 1006, and it is an even-odd deficient
number; its parts, 318, indicate two noble names, and they are Ghani, Basit. And know that His تعالى name al-Nur, al-Basit, and al-Zahir
are a remembrance for the people of unveilings. And whoever wishes to see something in his sleep, let him mention these names in complete purity
until a state from it overcomes him, and let him direct his resolve to what he wants, for that will be represented to him
in his sleep. And this is its form as you see.

(Chapter Seventy-Six on His تعالى name al-Batin)
This عظیم lordly name and the noble Samadani secret: whoever
mentions it often is secure from what he fears, his soul is tranquil, his heart expands, and his inward is illuminated. And whoever
persists in ذكره until his worlds are corrected and mention with him, then he does not come to the land of the awtad except that he incites it with righteousness
and obedience, and everyone who sees him loves him, and everyone who calls him is answered by his supplication. And in it are secrets for the people
of tawhid. And Shaykh
Zayn al-Din al-Kafi said from his books: its number, and the moon is increased in the light in a glass bowl, and he mentions it often until
a state from it overcomes him, and he erases it with rainwater and drinks it while he seeks unveilings and luminous knowledges, and nothing of the affairs of the world is hidden
from him except that he is informed of it in his sleep or waking according to his striving. If he is one of true
state and complete turning, the veil of the shell is lifted from his inward, so there is no need for explanation with it, rather that is a plain, verified unveiling
and a plain, successful description. And know—may Allah تعالى bring you out from the درجات of the dense to the درجات of the subtle—that every inward
is outward in relation to what is more inward than it. So the الأمر is inward to the creation, and whoever has the الأمر and the creation is inward from them.
So the inwardness of the الأمر is notional, not real, and the inward is in truth their mother when a swimmer from His light swims, it manifests every
inward, so it is as though it is exclusively for manifestation, while He is the one specified by inwardness. And upon this, it has the inwardness that
has no limit to its ending. And this name has from the number 62, and it is an even-odd deficient number; its parts, 34, indicate the inward of man,
which is his heart, since its number is 133, so it is written heart after heart of the Qur’an, which is expressed by YS, and to the heart
of the world, which is expressed by Muhammad, in some without some of the others in the weight of the others.
And His name al-Batin is the source of unity, and the heart is the locus of its manifestation, and Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, is more inward
than what appeared to creation and more outward than what was inward of the الأمر. As for another consideration, they indicate its name al-Mil and al-Sana. And as for
its square, it is upon this description as you see on the following page.

( Chapter seventy-seven on His, تعالى, name al-Wali )
This great name and the ancient secret is suitable for the rulers, the poles, the successors, the shaykhs,
and the murids, and everyone who has a flock over whose affair he takes charge. And whoever increases in ذكره, he is awe-inspiring
among all creation. And whoever places this square on paper, and the moon is increasing in light, and mentions its number while he
seeks a ولاية, he attains it. And it is from the number 47, and it is the number of the seven alif-lams, because of what is in the ولاية of the laggards with him
and the forty, because of what is in it of the establishment of kingship. As for the names of its letters, they are 207, and it is a number that indicates al-Jabbar and al-Jabir
and points to them. As for its square, it is this description

[Grid content preserved as-is]

( Chapter seventy-eight on His, تعالى, name Muta‘al )
This name, lofty in rank, exalted in proof, whoever increases in ذكره and enters upon one
of the princes and rulers, he obtains from it abundant fortune. And it is suitable as a dhikr for whoever is exposed
to a dispute or a trial. And if it is written in a sheet of lead in the exaltation of Saturn or its house, and the name’s number is mentioned,
551, every obstinate one is subdued by it. And whoever increases in ذكره, hardships become easy for him and every difficult thing is humbled to him. And it has the number 551,
and it is an odd deficient number, its parts being 41, indicating two noble letters, and they are two letters that indicate the completion of
getting free from the bonds of ranks, which is the custom of exaltation. And it is a square number from the multiplication of the first perfect number by itself. As for
its letters, they indicate two noble names, and they are Mukram Rashid. And this is its form

[Grid content preserved as-is]

( Chapter seventy-nine on His, تعالى, name Barr )
This noble name and beautiful designation, whoever increases in ذكره is treated with kindness
in all his states, and blessings are multiplied upon him. And whoever writes it on a sheet of
white silver and carries it, asks Allah تعالى for something and He gives it to him. And in it is safety
for the traveler on land and sea. And if the traveler increases in ذكره, Allah makes the demands easy for him and makes his path easy for him, and he is
protected in his family and his wealth. And if the wind rages upon the people of the ship and they are on the verge of drowning, and they increase in ذكره,
the good wind comes to them. And if the drinker of wine or the doer of sins increases in it, Allah تعالى repents upon him and he turns back
from that. If he mentions it every day seven hundred times, then he repents from that and returns from it. And it has from the number 402, verbally 202,
numerically. As for the first number, it is an odd even number; the Beneficial, the Protector, the Rescuer, and the Restorer count it without them by three, and it is

ومن أكثر من ذكره أنار الله تعالى باطنه ونور ظاهره فإن كان صاحب حاجة صادقة ظهر النور
من قلبه على وجهه وصار يخرج النور من فمه حال الذكر حتى يملأ خلوته وما حولها وفي ذكره
أسرار لأرباب البدايات وأنوار لأهل النهايات ومن ذكره في بيت مظلم وعيناه مفتوحتان إلى أن
يغلب عليه منه حال شاهد أنواراً عجيبة تملأ قلبه وهو اسم شريف يصلح لأهل الكاشفات
ومن أضاف إليه البديع وثلاثة بعد صوم ورياضة إلى أن يغلب عليه منه حال خلو
معدة وصفاء باطن فإنه ينتج الضوء سراج وهو مخصوص بأهل البصائر من أهل الله تعالى وله

(Chapter ninety-three concerning His تعالى name, Light)
This noble, attractive name and the beautiful, captivating secret: whoever increases in mentioning it, God تعالى
illumines his heart with the light of faith. And whoever combines the name al-Nur and al-Nafi‘ in a wafq and carries it sees
strange matters from the secrets of support with life inwardly and, more importantly, outwardly. It has the number 256,
and it is among the names; its letters are in the ranks of its numbers, and it is an even cube deficient from its root by one, indicating the name
Gabriel عليه السلام and two noble names, and they are Everlasting among them. As for the names of its letters, they indicate His تعالى name
the Originator, with al-. And Abu عبد الله al-Tarabulsi, قدس الله سره, said: whenever a matter concerns a person or he strays from a path
and he mentions this name with sound resolve and sincere intention, God تعالى guides him to the path whenever he intends.
And whoever increases in mentioning it, God تعالى illuminates his inward and brightens his outward. If he is a person of a true need, the light appears
from his heart upon his face, and light begins to emerge from his mouth during the ذكر until it fills his seclusion and what is around it. In its ذكر
there are secrets for the people of beginnings and lights for the people of ends. And whoever mentions it in a dark house and his eyes are open until
a state from it overcomes him, he sees wondrous lights filling his heart, and it is a noble name suitable for the people of unveilings.
And whoever adds to it al-Badi‘ and three after fasting and spiritual discipline until a state of empty
stomach and purity of inward overcomes him from it, then it produces light, a lamp, and it is مخصوص to the people of insights among the people of God تعالى. And it has
a square of great value, known to the people of pure hearts, and this is its form.

(Chapter ninety-four concerning His تعالى name, Guide)
This manifest, exalted name and the brilliant, lofty, evident secret is suitable for every wayfarer in
his wayfaring so long as he is sincere toward the light, and it is among the noble names. So if it is placed in a square thus: ha
alif dal ya, and he carries it and increases in mentioning it, he will be successful in good things in all his outward
and inward actions and states. And whoever places it in a silver ring in the exaltation of the moon and carries it with him is granted success in righteous deeds. And if it is hung
on the neck of a child who does not find his way to suckling, then he finds it. And whoever has strayed from the path, let him mention it; God
تعالى will guide him to it and to what is right in every matter he intends. And whoever enters into darkness and says, O Guide, guide me, then he is guided to
his sought thing. And in it there are strange secrets for the people of states, and it is from the ذكر of Israfil. And whoever writes it on an orange four
times on the first of Wednesday, and the moon is increasing in light, and wipes it with the leaves of its tree, and recites over it the name
every day fifty times, then it neither increases nor decreases nor vanishes ever. And in it there is a noble secret for kings and grandees, and how
many a king increased in mentioning it until a state from it overcomes him, except that the lands obeyed him and the servants became subject to him. And in it there is a
wonderful meaning for whoever desires to ascend with his spirit to the world of abiding among the wayfarers. It has the number 20, and it is the even of the even
and the odd; زيد ند, its parts 22, indicate His تعالى name, Reckoner. As for the names of its letters, they are 125, indicating His name,
Understanding of what is in guidance, of making understood the path from which one goes astray. And this is its form, the following page.

(Chapter seventeen in the properties of Kaf Ha Ya ‘Ayn Sad and their ربانيات الأقدسيات letters)
Know, O sincere seeker and desirous addressee—may Allah bring you to the alchemy of eternal happiness and the simiya of everlasting sovereignty—that the science of names is a noble, luminous science and a subtle, spiritual secret upon which the great among the saints and knowers relied, and upon which the eminent among the scholars, such as Imam al-Ghazali and al-Razi, depended. And it is from the لدنية sciences in its origin, and the الكشفية forms in its description, and the reality of adhering to it and turning to the subtle ones and the knowledges of the singular theophanies obtained for the people of singular turnings, and the effective in all that has from potential receptacles, and those who undertake it from the verifying knowers among the scholars is more than that its pillars should be stirred in the creed of the heedless ignorant. The Mirror of Secrets and the Center of the Circle of Lights, the Chosen Prophet, عليه الصلاة والسلام, said: “Indeed, among knowledge is that which is like the stored; none knows it except the scholars by Allah تعالى. فإذا تكلموا به أنكره أهل العزة بالله تعالى” poetry
She was jealous lest the sun see her face * without a veil, and the lover is jealous
So, O brothers of purity and O companions of loyalty, this is the treasured pearl, the sorrowed secret, the red sulfur
and the azure ruby; its indication is clear to the knowers. The chance of symbol has not veiled it, for trust in two concerns hidden in the books of blindness from
the atheists, and let not the hand of the deniers touch it with evil. In it are drinking places for the arrivals, and its chapters are drinking places for the wayfarers, so take it with understanding
if you are among those who understand. Is not a truer witness you? Yet you do not see. Only the tasters choose its springs, and none interprets
it except the interpreters, and none inhabits it, all the lights, the knowers. عليكم by following its decisive part, so it yields a remembrance for the worlds, and whatever is ambiguous
from it, then Allah is the best of openers. poetry
If the people, from the time of its knowledge, * had poured forth with insights and eyes
And do not think that this luminous science and the merciful secret flowed upon the tongue, so the expression was drawn, but rather every letter of it is luminous

**English:**
composite with a ظلمان letter, and from it were arranged a subtle, noble, and delightful minute thing, in a wondrous composition and strange ordering, after the unveiling of lofty sciences and sacred understandings, and the unraveling of spiritual symbols, and the untying of the talismans of divine treasures, and the theophanies of al-Samadaniyyah, and singular turnings, and pure drinking places, and ample sources, and extraordinary works, and truthful breaths, and the understanding of gnostic secrets, and luminous traces, and throne-like indications, and Sufi expressions, and tablet-like allusions, and inspired declarations, and the unveiling of letter-properties, and Indian numerals, and numerical wafqs, and لدنية knowledges, and فتحية subtleties, by which you reach the divine presence and the singular unity without distance in conduct and journeying, and without toil on a luminous path. So know that, and verify it, and understand it, and scrutinize it. That is the فضل of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills, and Allah is Possessor of عظیم فضل. And it is from His شأن, عز وجل, to give wisdom to whom He wills from His servants and to send down the secret upon whom He wills from His saints. If expansion assists, and time, and the arrangement and the time agree, and success aids, verification agrees, and you are relieved from preoccupations and the preoccupying grief, and the souls are removed from confusion and misery and hoarding, and you gather the scattered gathering and the all-encompassing knowledge, and you revive from the hours of your life pure times and honor from the days of time complete times, you have polished your spiritual understanding, the brides of your luminous understandings, so the gathering becomes repeated at the unveiling of the veil from the brides of secrets and the precious things of thoughts, in the spacious, flourishing garden and the dazzling silk-like wisdom, where one grieves over the saying: no intimate friend and no compassionate merciful one. For if the time is narrow for that, and the preventing مانع blocks the thread, then merchandise of value has come to you, in a house of sunnah, beautiful, splendid, virgin, desirable, in a Joseph-like form and a Mary-like conduct, and a musky breeze and a Meccan opening, honored, pure pages, purified, virgins, pure, peers, dazzling, untouched by thought, for their eyes a remembrance, and no understanding touches them, they are not compared, and they are because their oil is preserved and its secret stored, and its mother is sealed and its vessel is sealed together, a medicine attractive and a force that draws, and its garden is fragrant, and its love is shammar, and its river is flowing, and its bird is crying out, and its lightning is shining, and its cloud is pouring, and its light is rising, and its beauty is radiant, and its crescent is dazzling, and its desire is splendid, and its beauty is manifest, and its sky is subtleties, and its earth is knowledges, and its west is secrets, and its east is lights, and its facing is names, and its breast is names, and its form is wondrous, and its paper is wonder, and its secret is verses, and its fortress is recitations, its subtleties are solar, and its knowledges are sacred, and its writings are hidden, and its knowledge is preserved, none touches it except the purified, and none attains it except the working saints, and none knows it except the pure chosen ones, and none judges it except the verifying sages, and none attains it except the precise virtuous, and none meets it except the patient. poetry
Beauty bewildered in its loveliness * so it became, like the lovers, passionately devoted to it

For this reason, let the workers work, and in such as this let the competitors compete. And as for the benefits of the عظیم Qur’an, mention of it has a فضل after that; so let the essences be made pure with splendor like the greater lightning and the azure ruby. And know that the Qur’an is the preserved pearl, the stored knowledge, the sealed secret, the عظیم secret, the ancient treasure, the healing antidote, and the sufficient remedy. And it is the jewel, and its symbols, and the untying of the talismans of its treasures, and plunging into the seas of its secrets, and extracting its عظیم pearls from the depths of its lights, and standing upon its literal and numerical realities, and its directed benefits, and its individual and paired properties, and its wafq forms, and its samadani remembrances, and its spiritual secrets, and other than that of the secrets which none is informed of except the single ones among the firmly rooted and the perfect among the individuals of the knowers. That is فضل

الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم فمنهم قنع بالتفسير اللغوي من اللبوب وبما ظهر عما يظن
ومنهم من غره أمواجه فظفر بالكبريت الأحمر ومنهم من غاص في عمقه فاستخرج الياقوت الأحمر
والدر الأزهر والزبرجد الأخضر ومنهم من تعلق في آخر سواحله فاستخرج من حيوانها الترياق
الأكبر والمسك الأزفر وهو الذي عجز عنه الأولون والآخرون عن معارضته ووقف العاملون
في مقام الحصر دون منافعه وهو حبل الله المتين ونوره المبين وصراطه المستقيم وسبيله القويم وكلامه
القديم والبحر الذي لا تنقص عجائبه ولا تفنى غرائبه ولا يدرك مداه ولا يبلغ أوهام أقصاه والمميز عن
الطب والحيث والحلال والحرام لا يأتيه الباطل من بين يديه ولا من خلفه تنزيل من حكيم حميد
* واعلم أن العلماء أربعة علم حظه من الله الآخرة وعلم حظه من الله العلم والمعرفة وعلم حظه السر
إلى الآخرة وعلم يعلم السير إلى الآخرة فالأول مع الله بالله والثاني يدعو العلم بعلم الله والثالث يدعو
إلى الآخرة والرابع يدعو إلى الآخرة وروى عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال جالسوا
الحكماء وخالطوا العلماء واسألوا الحكماء لأن يلين الفهم وأتأول والتفسير خلافا شهيرا قال تعالى
سأصرف عن آياتي الذين يتكبرون في الأرض الآية قال ابن عباس وغيره إني سأنتزع منهم فهم
القرآن والعلماء في عبارات القرآن على ثلاثة أقسام الأول التفسير وهو أدناهم والثاني التأويل وهو
أوسطهم والثالث بالفهم وهو أجلهم فالتفسير بالتعلم والدراسة والبحث على أقاويل السلف والتأويل
بالهداية والتوفيق والفقه من الله تعالى والقياس والعقل فأهل الفهم ينطقون بالله تعالى كما

ينطقون بشيء حتى يظهرهم وقال بعضهم عند قوله تعالى وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي
ولا محدث وهم أهل الفهم الذين ينطقون من الحكماء * وروى عن بعض الصحابة أنه قال لأنكم
تقرؤون ظاهرا وأنا أقرأ باطنا فالغرض المقصود من ذلك تعلم شرف الباطن الذي فهموا عن
الله تعالى بأسرار التدبير وأنوار التذكير ولطائف التفكر ما أراد الله تعالى في باطن آياته من

الذي يسقى منه علوم الأولين والآخرين قال تعالى ما فرطنا في الكتاب من شيء وما من سر من

أبطن وقد قال الإمام علي كرم الله وجهه ظاهره أنيق وباطنه عميق لا تفنى عجائبه ولا تنقضي غرائبه

للصديقين والحقائق للنبيين ثم تحت كل كلمة بل تحت كل حرف منه حكم عاج وبحر عجاج وافق
مواج فإذا قرأ الشاهد من العارفين والصادق من المحبين أعطى لكل حرف منه ألف فهم ولكل
فهم ألف فطنة ولكل فهم ألف عبرة والعبرة لا يقوم بها من في السموات والأرض فذلك
قال تعالى ومن يؤت الحكمة فقد أوتى خيرا كثيرا معنى فهم القرآن ومعانيه وقال بعض العلماء لكل
آية من القرآن ستون ألف فهم وما بقي من فهمها فهو أكثر قال بعضهم القرآن محتو على سبعة وسبعين

**English:**
— 201 —

Allah gives it to whom He wills, and Allah is Possessor of the عظیم فضل; so among them is one content with the linguistic interpretation from the lubub and with what has appeared from what is thought, and among them is one whom its waves deceived, so he attained the red الكبريت, and among them is one who dived into its depth and extracted the red ruby and the bright pearl and the green emerald, and among them is one who clung to the end of its shores and extracted from its animal the greater antidote and the blue musk, and it is that which the الأولون and the الآخرون were unable to oppose, and the workers stood in the مقام of restriction without its benefits, and it is the firm Rope of Allah and His manifest Light and His straight Path and His upright Way and His ancient Speech and the sea whose wonders do not diminish and whose marvels do not perish and whose extent is not reached and whose utmost is not attained by imaginations, and the distinguisher between medicine and حيث and the lawful and the unlawful; falsehood does not come to it from before it nor from behind it, a revelation from One Wise, Praiseworthy.

* And know that the scholars are four: knowledge whose share from Allah is the Hereafter; and knowledge whose share from Allah is knowledge and gnosis; and knowledge whose share is the secret to the Hereafter; and knowledge that knows the journey to the Hereafter. So the first is with Allah by Allah, and the second calls knowledge by the knowledge of Allah, and the third calls to the Hereafter, and the fourth calls to the Hereafter. And it is narrated from the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وسلم, that he said: Sit with the sages, and mix with the scholars, and ask the sages, because understanding becomes softened. And I interpret and the interpretation is a famous disagreement. He, تعالى, said: “I shall turn away from My signs those who are arrogant in the earth” the verse. Ibn Abbas and others said: I shall surely tear from them the understanding of the Qur’an. And the scholars in the expressions of the Qur’an are in three categories: the first is tafsir, and it is the lowest of them; and the second is ta’wil, and it is the middle of them; and the third is by understanding, and it is the most eminent of them. So tafsir is by learning and study and research upon the sayings of the predecessors, and ta’wil is by guidance and success and jurisprudence from Allah تعالى and analogy and reason. So the people of understanding speak by Allah تعالى, as He said: “I was his tongue by which he speaks,” to the end of the report. * And for the wise, Allah تعالى began upon the mouths of the sages, so they do not speak with anything until He manifests them. And some of them said at His saying تعالى: “And We sent not before you any messenger nor prophet nor muhaddath,” and they are the people of understanding who speak from the sages. * And it is narrated from some of the Companions that he said: because you read outwardly, and I read inwardly. So the intended purpose of that is learning the nobility of the inward, which they understood from Allah تعالى by the secrets of management, the lights of admonition, and the subtleties of contemplation, what Allah تعالى intended in the inward of His verses from the states of His will. And the عظیم Qur’an is the concealed Book and the stored secret and the preserved pearl, and it is the encompassing sea from which the sciences of the الأولين and the الآخرين are watered. He تعالى said: “We have not neglected in the Book anything,” and there is no secret from the secrets except that it is contained in it. And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم said: “Indeed the Qur’an has an outward and an inward, up to seven inward aspects.” And Imam Ali, may Allah ennoble his face, said: Its outward is elegant and its inward is deep; its wonders do not perish and its marvels do not end. And there is no verse from the Qur’an except that it has seven meanings: outward and inward and indications and signs and subtleties and realities. So the outward is for the common people, and the inward for the elect, and the indications for the elect of the elect, and the signs for the saints, and the subtleties for the truthful ones, and the realities for the prophets. Then beneath every word, rather beneath every letter of it, is a ruling, a rushing sea, a roaring sea, a surging sea. So when the witness from among the knowers and the truthful one from among the lovers reads, it gives to every letter of it a thousand understandings, and to every understanding a thousand sharpnesses, and to every understanding a thousand lessons; and the lesson is not upheld by those in the heavens and the earth. Thus He تعالى said: “And whoever is given wisdom has been given much good,” meaning the understanding of the Qur’an and its meanings. And some of the scholars said: for every verse of the Qur’an are sixty thousand understandings, and what remains of its understanding is more. Some of them said: the Qur’an contains seventy-seven
